messages:
Priya (partnerships): Quick sync — APAC lab capacity + embargo windows for Gaudi & MI300. Need final announce sequencing by EOD PT. Can partners confirm SKU readiness, thermal derate plans, and any embargo constraints?

Alex (eng-planning): Short: APAC racks at 72% for next 4 weeks, hotspot is KIX region. If MI300 shipments slip we need to move 6 Gaudi slots to EU temporarily.

Kim (platform): @Priya what's the hard embargo date from marketing? we need 48h prior for canary pushes and marketplace tagging.

Priya (partnerships): Marketing embargo = 2026-04-10 00:00 UTC. That gives us ~17 days. We need partner sign-off on final SKUs + driver images by 2026-04-07 18:00 UTC.

NVIDIA_ops: H100 availability: still constrained across APAC; H200 inventory improving. If MI300 is delayed, we can offer H200-based dedicated pools as a fallback. Note: H200 perf on long-seqs ~10% lower for some LLM kernels.

Gaudi_PM: Gaudi canary image v2 ready, but we discovered a thermal derate at sustained 90% util on newest OEM firmware. We have a mitigation: reduce sustained clock by 5% + adjust fan curve. Need OEM signoff to ship on marketplace.

Dan (solutions): For SI installs, customers expect the exact firmware tag in the release notes. Please include a short ops snippet we can paste into the SI runbook.

Kim (platform): Putting the ops snippet here for SI copy/paste:

```
# SI runbook snippet (thermal derate mitigation)
# apply during image bake -> post-deploy validation
set-fan-profile --region=apac --profile=aggressive
apply-clk-derate --gpu-family=gaudi --percent=5
validate-load --bench=lm-longseq --target-p95-latency<=120ms
```

Priya (partnerships): Thanks. Two asks from partners: 1) final SKU list (marketplace tags), 2) embargo exceptions (if any) and timelines for driver/fix releases.

NVIDIA_ops: We'll send SKU list by tomorrow EOD APAC. Driver fix timeline: tentative image roll 2026-04-05 -> staggered rollout to regions over 48h.

Gaudi_PM: Marketplace tags below (draft):
- gaudi.xlarge: gaudi-canary-image:v2
- gaudi.dedicated.apac: gaudi-prod-image:v1.4
We need marketplace team to confirm SKU naming constraints.

Alex (eng-planning): Note: If MI300 falls behind more than 10 days, plan B = shift 6 reserved slots to H200 in APAC and run a traffic-split experiment 80/20 (Gaudi/H200) for 72 hours. Monitoring: token-cost delta and p95 latency.

Dan (solutions): For SI integration: add this checklist item -> "confirm firmware tag matches marketplace release". If mismatch, rollback to previous image.

Priya (partnerships): Quick decision matrix for announce sequencing:
```
- green: SKUs confirmed by 2026-04-07 18:00 UTC -> announce 2026-04-10
- amber: SKUs partial / images staggered -> announce with note: "phased region availability"
- red: critical firmware/stock missing -> hold announcement and trigger customer comms
```

Kim (platform): Canary pipeline status: gaudi-canary-image:v2 built, tests passing 37/38 (one perf regression on longseq). Deploy-bot will run a targeted canary to 3 hosts in KIX.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started -> hosts: apac-kix-03, apac-kix-07, apac-kix-11. Log: https://ci.redwood.example/canary/1729999999

NVIDIA_ops: FYI — if canary perf regression persists, we recommend bumping quantization profile to q4f16 for affected models; tradeoff: slightly higher token cost.

Priya (partnerships): Action items summary: @NVIDIA_ops send SKU + driver timeline by 2026-04-01 EOD APAC; @Gaudi_PM confirm marketplace tag conventions + OEM signoff for thermal mitigations by 2026-04-03; @platform (Kim) validate canary perf regression threshold and rollback plan. We'll reconvene Mon 09:00 PT if any open items.

Alex (eng-planning): I'll draft the announce sequencing with the three states (green/amber/red) and a short blurb for marketing to adapt.

Dan (solutions): Adding SI runbook note to the shared doc now -> https://docs.redwood.example/si/runbooks/hw-onramp

Priya (partnerships): Great. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
